title: berteroa incana subsp. stricta
intro: Berteroa incana subsp. stricta, commonly known as White Bryony, is a plant species in the family Brassicaceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties that can aid in wound healing and reduce fever. The therapeutic actions of Berteroa incana subsp. stricta include its ability to act as a diuretic, anti-diarrheal, and expectorant, making it useful in treating various health conditions such as urinary issues and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Berteroa incana subsp. stricta include isothiocyanates, glycosides, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
